import type { Database } from 'better-sqlite3'
import {

} from '@/db/schema.js'

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom Error Classes
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Thrown when a quote is not found. */
export class QuoteNotFoundError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly id: string) {
    super(`Quote not found: ${id}`)
    this.name = 'QuoteNotFoundError'
  }
}

/** Thrown when an operation requires draft status but the quote is not in draft state. */
export class QuoteNotDraftError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly id: string, public readonly currentStatus: string) {
    super(`Quote ${id} is not in draft state (current: ${currentStatus}). Only draft quotes can be modified.`)
    this.name = 'QuoteNotDraftError'
  }
}

/** Thrown when a quote line item is not found. */
export class QuoteLineItemNotFoundError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly id: string) {
    super(`Quote line item not found: ${id}`)
    this.name = 'QuoteLineItemNotFoundError'
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Types — request/response shapes
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type QuoteStatus = 'draft' | 'sent' | 'converted' | 'rejected'

export interface QuoteListResult {
  quotes: Array<{
    id: string
    quoteNumber: string
    customerId: string | null
    status: QuoteStatus
    notes: string | null
    createdAt: number
    updatedAt: number
  }>
  total: number
}

export interface QuoteDetail {
  id: string
  quoteNumber: string
  customerId: string | null
  status: QuoteStatus
  notes: string | null
  lineItems: QuoteLineItem[]
  createdAt: number
  updatedAt: number
}

export interface QuoteLineItem {
  id: string
  quoteId: string
  lineType: 'part' | 'labor' | 'bicycle'
  partId: string | null
  laborServiceId: string | null
  description: string
  quantity: number
  unitPriceNet: number
  vatRateId: string
  discountPercent: number | null
  lineTotalNet: number
  lineTotalVat: number
  lineTotalGross: number
  bicycleId: string | null
  bicycleBrand: string | null
  bicycleModel: string | null
  bicycleYear: number | null
  bicycleColor: string | null
  bicycleFrameSize: string | null
  createdAt: number
}



// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helper — Get VAT rate for a given vatRateId
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function getVatRate(vatRateId: string): Promise<{ rate: number }> {
  const [rate] = await db.select({ rate: vatRates.rate }).from(vatRates).where(eq(vatRates.id, vatRateId))
  if (!rate) {
    throw new Error(`VAT rate not found: ${vatRateId}`)
  }
  return rate
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helper — Generate quote number from sequence
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function generateQuoteNumber(): Promise<string> {
  const updateResult = await db
    .update(sequences)
    .set({ currentValue: sql`${sequences.currentValue} + 1` })
    .where(eq(sequences.name, 'quote'))

  if (updateResult.changes === 0) {
    // Sequence doesn't exist yet — create it starting at 1
    await db.insert(sequences).values({ name: 'quote', currentValue: 1 })
  }

  const [seqRow] = await db
    .select({ currentValue: sequences.currentValue })
    .from(sequences)
    .where(eq(sequences.name, 'quote'))

  const seqNum = seqRow!.currentValue
  return `QT-${String(seqNum).padStart(4, '0')}`
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helper — Enforce draft-only access on a quote
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function enforceDraftStatus(quoteId: string): Promise<void> {
  const [quote] = await db.select({ status: quotes.status }).from(quotes).where(eq(quotes.id, quoteId))

  if (!quote) {
    throw new QuoteNotFoundError(quoteId)
  }

  if (quote.status !== 'draft') {
    throw new QuoteNotDraftError(quoteId, quote.status)
  }
}

 * Create a new draft quote with auto-generated quote number.

  customerId?: string | null
  notes?: string | null
}): Promise<QuoteDetail> {
  const quoteNumber = await generateQuoteNumber()
  const now = Date.now()

  const [inserted] = await db
    .insert(quotes)
    .values({
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      quoteNumber,
      customerId: input.customerId ?? null,
      status: 'draft',
